text: {"assessment":[{"ids":["p16","p23","p19","p21","p18"],"relation":"corroborating","note":"July 2024 StatCan total and its main published components: non-intermodal loadings, intermodal shipments originating in Canada, and US-connection traffic reconcile closely with the reported total, with a small residual. p18 gives the five-year July average, showing July 2024 was just below normal. Same source, so not independent confirmation."},{"ids":["p61","p62","p63","p64","p65","p66","p67","p68","p69"],"relation":"corroborating","note":"2025 StatCan monthly and annual totals and components. December components reconcile with the December total; annual non-intermodal, intermodal and US-connection totals are consistent with the annual all-traffic total. Shared StatCan source and overlapping definitions."},{"ids":["p190","p191","p192","p193","p194","p195","p196","p197","p198","p199","p200","p201","p202","p203","p204"],"relation":"corroborating","note":"February 2026 StatCan release: total and component tonnages reconcile; February 2026 is just under the February 2024 record. The strong February 2026 year-over-year gain is same-source and different-period evidence, not a contradiction, but it should not be extrapolated directly to July."},{"ids":["p111","p113","p114","p115","p116","p117","p118","p119","p120","p121"],"relation":"corroborating","note":"CTRF/StatCan-derived June 2025 total and components plus 2025 weekly and cumulative rail traffic. All support downside risk for July 2026 but cover only one carrier/one corridor."},{"ids":["p191","p163","p164"],"relation":"conflicting","note":"Early-2026 national strength (February 2026 up strongly year over year) conflicts in direction with CN's late-July 2026 negative weekly carload and RTM signals. They do not map directly to Canada-level StatCan monthly tonnage without a carrier-share and tonnes-per-carload/RTM bridge, so they are not used as direct substitutes."},{"ids":["p233","p308","p338"],"relation":"redundant","note":"Representative entries from the CEIC 2020 block; p233-p262 and p308-p352 repeat the same intermodal, non-intermodal and commodity series in multiple copies/vintages. They are old and duplicate each other; not used for the July 2026 level."},{"ids":["p106","p293","p294","p295","p296","p297"],"relation":"contextual","note":"Coal annual lower-bound and 2015 Canadian weekly carload data are from much earlier periods and different definitions. Against that, p163/p164 show CN late-July 2026 RTM and carloads down year over year, and p186/p187 identify a major wildfire disruption near a key northern Ontario corridor. The net central factor is near flat but with wide uncertainty.","applies_when":"July 2026 national conditions are broadly consistent with a flat-to-slightly-negative July versus the annual-implied July 2025 level, and CN's late-July weakness is representative enough of the national month.","falsified_by":"Full-month Canadian weekly or StatCan data showing July 2026 up more than about 8% or down more than about 10% versus July 2025 would overturn the central setting.","route":"m1"},{"id":"a2","name":"July 2026 non-intermodal tonnage relative to July 2024","value":1.0,"low":0.9,"high":1.1,"unit":"ratio","rationale":"Annual 2025 non-intermodal loadings (p67) were only marginally above 2024, while February 2026 non-intermodal traffic (p193/p194) was strong year over year. CN late-July 2026 weakness and wildfire disruption argue against extrapolating the February strength into July.","applies_when":"Non-intermodal bulk and commodity loadings in July 2026 stay near their July 2024 level after accounting for the mixed 2025-26 signals.","falsified_by":"Evidence that July 2026 grain, coal, potash or other bulk loadings were far above or below their 2024 July levels.","route":"m2"},{"id":"a3","name":"July 2026 intermodal tonnage relative to July 2024","value":1.12,"low":1.0,"high":1.25,"unit":"ratio","rationale":"Intermodal evidence is consistently firmer: p195/p196 show February 2026 intermodal up strongly year over year, p65 shows December 2025 intermodal up, and p113 showed June 2025 intermodal up. This supports a July 2026 intermodal level above July 2024, but port and corridor disruptions keep the range wide.","applies_when":"Containerised intermodal traffic continues the 2025-26 upward trend through July 2026.","falsified_by":"July 2026 port/terminal or rail data showing intermodal loadings flat or falling versus 2024.","route":"m2"},{"id":"a4","name":"July 2026 US-connection tonnage relative to July 2024","value":0.9,"low":0.78,"high":1.02,"unit":"ratio","rationale":"p69 and p287/p288 show 2025 US-connection tonnage down sharply from 2024, and p201/p290-p291 show the US-connection share falling in 2025. February 2026 US-connection tonnage rebounded strongly (p197/p198), but from a depressed base. A central factor below one versus July 2024 is appropriate, with a wide range.","applies_when":"US-connection traffic in July 2026 remains below its 2024 July level but above the weakest 2025 months.","falsified_by":"Data showing July 2026 US-connection loadings back at or above July 2024 levels.","route":"m2"},{"id":"a5","name":"Residual/other component growth factor relative to July 2024","value":1.0,"low":0.8,"high":1.2,"unit":"ratio","rationale":"The residual is the small difference between the published July 2024 total and the three published components; it mainly reflects rounding, residual categories and definitional edges. It should scale approximately with total traffic rather than be extrapolated independently.","applies_when":"The published total continues to equal the sum of the non-intermodal, intermodal, US-connection and residual parts.","falsified_by":"A definitional change or a large unexplained residual in the July 2026 release.","route":"m2"},{"id":"a6","name":"July 2026 total freight tonnage relative to the 2024 five-year July average","value":0.99,"low":0.9,"high":1.08,"unit":"ratio","rationale":"p18 gives a five-year July average of 30.3 million tonnes as of 2024, and p16 shows July 2024 just below that average. Annual 2025 was essentially flat versus 2024, while early 2026 was strong and late-July 2026 CN metrics were negative. A near-average July 2026 with wide uncertainty is the appropriate central setting.","applies_when":"July 2026 remains close to the recent normal July range rather than shifting with the exceptional February 2026 strength.","falsified_by":"July 2026 national tonnage far outside the recent five-year July range.","route":"m3"},{"id":"a7","name":"July 2026 total freight tonnage relative to June 2025","value":0.98,"low":0.87,"high":1.1,"unit":"ratio","rationale":"p111 gives June 2025 total cargo at 29.8 million tonnes, down from June 2024. July typically sits below June in the 2024 seasonal pattern, so a July 2026 factor near or slightly below one relative to June 2025 is reasonable. CN late-July 2026 weakness and wildfire disruption pull the central value down, while early-2026 strength pulls it up.","applies_when":"June-to-July seasonality in 2026 is similar to 2024 and the 2026 annual level is within a few percent of 2025.","falsified_by":"Evidence that July 2026 rail tonnage was well above June 2025 or far below the usual June-to-July seasonal drop.","route":"m4"}],"methods":[{"id":"m1","method":"formula_mc","unit":"t/month","params":{"formula":"p16 * (p62 / p63) * a1","inputs":{"p16":{"id":"p16","role":"July 2024 total freight tonnage carried by Canadian railways, Canada, metric tonnes per month"},"p62":{"id":"p62","role":"full-year 2025 total freight tonnage carried by Canadian railways, Canada, metric tonnes per year"},"p63":{"id":"p63","role":"full-year 2024 total freight tonnage carried by Canadian railways, Canada, metric tonnes per year"},"a1":{"id":"a1","role":"factor for July 2026 total freight tonnage relative to the July 2025 level implied by p16, p62 and p63"}}},"coverage":{"kind":"full"},"rationale":"Uses the observed July 2024 total as the seasonal base, adjusts it by the observed annual 2024-to-2025 change, then applies a July 2026 change factor. This reuses the round-1 route but replaces part of the long gap with the observed annual 2025/2024 ratio. Key failure: the July share of annual tonnage may differ from 2024, and the CN/wildfire signals may not represent all carriers."},{"id":"m2","method":"formula_mc","unit":"t/month","params":{"formula":"p23 * a2 + p19 * a3 + p21 * a4 + (p16 - p23 - p19 - p21) * a5","inputs":{"p23":{"id":"p23","role":"July 2024 non-intermodal freight loadings, Canada, metric tonnes per month"},"p19":{"id":"p19","role":"July 2024 intermodal shipments originating in Canada, metric tonnes per month"},"p21":{"id":"p21","role":"July 2024 freight traffic arriving from the United States by rail, Canada, metric tonnes per month"},"p16":{"id":"p16","role":"July 2024 total freight tonnage carried by Canadian railways, Canada, metric tonnes per month, used only to derive the small residual component"},"a2":{"id":"a2","role":"factor for July 2026 non-intermodal tonnage relative to July 2024"},"a3":{"id":"a3","role":"factor for July 2026 intermodal tonnage relative to July 2024"},"a4":{"id":"a4","role":"factor for July 2026 US-connection tonnage relative to July 2024"},"a5":{"id":"a5","role":"factor for the residual/other component in July 2026 relative to its July 2024 value"}},"},"coverage":{"kind":"sum","dimension":"channel","parts":["non-intermodal","intermodal","US rail connections","residual"],"missing":[]},"rationale":"Rebuilds the total from the published July 2024 channels and applies separate transfer factors for bulk/non-intermodal, intermodal, US-connection and residual traffic. The component sum is definitionally aligned with p16 in the 2024 release. Key failure: category definitions or overlap may differ over time, and the factors rely on commodity-specific trends rather than full July 2026 data."},{"id":"m3","method":"formula_mc","unit":"t/month","params":{"formula":"p18 * a6","inputs":{"p18":{"id":"p18","role":"five-year average total freight tonnage carried by Canadian railways for the month of July as of 2024, metric tonnes per month"},"a6":{"id":"a6","role":"factor for July 2026 total freight tonnage relative to the 2024 five-year July average"}}},"coverage":{"kind":"full"},"rationale":"Uses the observed five-year July average as a seasonal normal and applies a July 2026 factor based on the flat 2025 annual total, early-2026 strength and late-July 2026 CN weakness. Key failure: the five-year average window predates 2024-26 structural changes and does not reflect current commodity mix."},{"id":"m4","method":"formula_mc","unit":"t/month","params":{"formula":"p111 * a7","inputs":{"p111":{"id":"p111","role":"total cargo carried by Canadian railways, June 2025, metric tonnes per month"},"a7":{"id":"a7","role":"factor for July 2026 total freight tonnage relative to June 2025, including June-to-July seasonality and annual change"}}},"coverage":{"kind":"full"},"rationale":"Uses the observed June 2025 monthly level as the most recent full pre-2026 monthly total available in this route and applies a combined seasonal/annual factor to July 2026. Key failure: June 2025 is not July and the June-to-July seasonal ratio is not observed for 2026; the factor must carry both seasonality and trend."},{"id":"m5","method":"formula_mc","unit":"t/month","params":{"formula":"p190 * p16 / p192","inputs":{"p190":{"id":"p190","role":"total cargo carried by Canadian railways, February 2026, metric tonnes per month"},"p16":{"id":"p16","role":"July 2024 total freight tonnage carried by Canadian railways, Canada, metric tonnes per month"},"p192":{"id":"p192","role":"record high total tonnage for February, February 2024, metric tonnes per month"}}},"coverage":{"kind":"full"},"rationale":"Uses the observed February 2026 total, which the release describes as just under the February 2024 record, and applies the 2024 seasonal ratio between July and that record February. This is an independent recent-level route. Key failure: February-to-July seasonality may differ between 2024 and 2026, especially with the reported 2026 wildfire and CN operational weakness."}]}
